parts.description: One entry per part: cpu, motherboard, memory, gpu, psu, case, cooler (and an optional storage list). Give each a name plus any specs you know (see the README for field names). Where you leave a spec out and we hold maker data for that exact part, we fill it in and cite the maker page.
